reason: This plugin is primarily a DSH plugin-management utility embedded in the Settings UI, centered on adding an "Install" tab for installing, uninstalling, and updating plugins. Evidence in the repository README and package manifest shows it is a web DSH plugin with client wiring that performs plugin lifecycle operations using the existing `dsh plugin add/remove` path, with support for npm, GitHub-style, and local path specs, plus in-UI update checking.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH 设置页的插件管理界面插件，可在客户端直接通过包名、GitHub 或本地路径安装、更新和卸载第三方插件。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Settings-page plugin manager that lets users install, update, and remove third-party plugins from the client UI using package specs, GitHub, or local paths.

capabilities: Install third-party DSH plugins from the Settings UI
Uninstall installed DSH plugins from the same UI
Check and apply plugin updates from within the plugin interface
Accepts multiple install specs including package specs, GitHub repo spec, and local path
Delegates actions to the existing DSH CLI plugin add/remove workflow
Includes UI behavior for standalone/desktop restart guidance after install changes
